title: sydraQL Query Telemetry
summary: Run real sydraQL queries and surface execution mode, fallback behavior, trace ids, and operator timings directly in the UI.
whySQLiteFallsShort: SQLite can execute SQL, but SydraDB exposes time-series-native query telemetry and compiler state as part of the product surface instead of an afterthought.
The query response explains how the engine executed the request, which makes compiler rollout and performance work visible while the product is still changing quickly.
Native time-series selectors and telemetry let storage and compiler engineers validate behavior against real data without bolting on external tracing first.

steps.title: Compute a host-level aggregate
steps.summary: Run a grouped aggregate over tagged time-series data and inspect the execution telemetry returned with the rows.
steps.query: select tag.host as host, avg(value) as avg_value from edge.power_kw where tag.site = 'edge-east' group by tag.host

steps.title: Inspect first and last values
steps.summary: Use first/last aggregates to demonstrate stateful operators and confirm the baseline time window is read correctly.
steps.query: select first(value) as first_value, last(value) as last_value from edge.power_kw where time >= 1700000000
